main_text.p: cjusque defolatione, per annos Lxx duratură: quo opere publicè ostendit nec eum cultum per se hominem Deo conciliare, sine quo multi in exilio tamen Deo placerent. Nec gratum fuisse sibi eum cultum sine fide in Christum, salvatorem venturum: cum ejus instrumenta hostibus conculcanda & profananda objiceret. Hinc aliquis datus fidelibus, in captivitate degentibus, prægustus temporis, quo sine cæremoniis templo alligatis Deum colerent homines, illique ex merâ fide, sine sacrificiis legis, placerent. 3. Abductione populi inter gentes (quæ abhinc non amplius ignorarent legem & ipsum [?] populi) præparavit Deus vocationem gentium; ut potuerint postea legem & prophetas conferre cum annunciatione euangelii. 4. Ablatione inhabitationis divinæ majestatis à templo, & oraculorum per urim & Thum-mim à populo, præsagiebat Deus instare alium revelationis modum, quo vellet post castigationum consummationem populum suum beare, eum compellaturus per filium suum: nec non damna illa compensare majoribus N. T. bonis, cujus œconomia sine istis querelis, quas effuderant sancti sub priori testamento, longè foret fua-vior, & quoad methodum doctrinæ efficacior.

page.notes: The word in the parenthesis after "ipsum" is blurred ("fpem"); read as "ipsum" with [?]. The word "fua-vior" is broken at the line end and keeps its printed hyphen. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The printed "cjus" is kept as printed. Show-through from the reverse side is visible on the right and was left out. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
